planets.name: TOI-5126 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-5126 with a 17.9-day year, found in 2023.

text.card: TOI-5126 c was found in 2023 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around TOI-5126. Its orbit and size follow Fairnington et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
